about: Vanilla sprite fallback. example_mod ships no sprite files, and its PEASANT override defines only one leg variant of one phase. Loading a big save (fixture 'modded', full of peasants in cells) on example_mod's map used to crash in scr_set_slot_spr_part (empty sprite array). Now the override takes whatever it lacks, or failed to load, from the vanilla peasant, and the game plays on.
why_no_boot_suite: example_mod ships sprite paths only, so the sprite checks of the boot suite fail by design.
